import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        StringBuilder ans = new StringBuilder();
        ans.append(s.charAt(0));
        boolean used = false;
        int n = s.length();
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (i + 3 < n && s.substring(i, i + 3).equals("dot")) {
                ans.append('.');
                i += 2;
            } else if (s.charAt(i) == 'a' && i + 1 < n - 1 && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && !used) {
                ans.append('@');
                used = true;
                i++;
            } else {
                ans.append(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans.toString());
    }
}
